company.name: Babil Games
company.shortDescription: Babil Games is a top-tier mobile game publisher in the MENA region with international operations.
company.description: Founded in 2012 and based in Dubai and Amman, Babil Games became part of Stillfront Group AB, listed on First North Premier Growth Market in Stockholm, in 2016. Babil Games helps developers from around the world to successfully navigate international markets, with a focus on the MENA region, the world’s fastest-growing games market, and bring gamers culture-adapted, high-quality entertainment in their native tongue. Babil’s success stems from its passionate, creative, high-spirited, and dedicated team of talented artists and experienced professionals. Within a few months of the release of its first game, Nida Harb, Babil Games ranked in the Top-10 on iOS App Store for its outstanding strategy-action game.
